newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm on western investment buying.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm on western investment buying.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds rose on Thursday on foreign investment buying after Wednesday's news that President Boris Yeltsin is likely to undergo surgery in 6-8 weeks, dealers said.
Cardiologists decided on Wednesday that Yeltsin should undergo heart surgery but they set no date for the operation. They said it would take 6-8 weeks to prepare Yeltsin for it.
Dealers said trading started today from higher levels as foreign operators had been actively buying on Wednesday after Moscow closed.
"Prices are fluctuating today and active, apparently client, buying is seen from London," a Russian bank dealer said.
Avtobank dealer Alla Zakharova said: "Foreigner operators must have trusted the foreign doctors and Western banks are closing their short positions actively."

Dealers said the fourth and fifth tranches were at the centre of the market's attention. They forecast prices were likely to stabilise at current levels or firm a little on continuing investment interest.
